summary_1line: Salya defeats and wounds Virata, Satanika is slain, Arjuna routs the Rakshasa Alamvusha, and several duels rage across the battlefield.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Rakshasa Alamvusha charges in a chariot drawn by eight steeds with a shrieking vulture standard and grotesque spirits yoked beside blood-red banners.
Virata, his horses slain, stands on the ground beside his shattered chariot and fires arrows upward at Salya in blazing fury.
Arjuna calmly shatters Alamvusha’s bow, chariot, driver, and steeds with successive arrows as the demon reels under the assault.
